Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the two docs. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Residency requirement: all customer data and inference requests must remain in the EU; we can’t accept any routing to the US for processing. Storing or replicating logs outside EU is not allowed unless explicitly anonymized and approved.
2) Preferred path: Hosted API if you can provide a contractual guarantee that requests and logs are processed and stored only in EU regions (we saw in the matrix that eu-west-1 + eu-central-1 are supported). If Hosted can’t provide this guarantee, we will evaluate Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity in an EU region) or Private VPC (customer-controlled networking).
3) KMS: we require customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for encryption at rest. HSM or a KMS integration is preferred.
4) Timeline: procurement needs to understand commercial delta between Hosted (with contractual residency) vs Dedicated vs Private. Can you provide a sample quote range or delta %?

We’re happy to schedule the technical deep-dive. Availability next week: Wed 28 Jul 09:00-11:00 CET or Thu 29 Jul 14:00-16:00 CET.

Regards,
Sofie Müller
Head of Cloud Risk — NordBank
sofie.muller@nordbank.de

Hi Sofie —

Thanks — answers inline below and added Lukas + Vivek for technical details.

Residency / Hosted API:
- Hosted API can be configured to serve traffic only from EU regions (we have eu-west-1 and eu-central-1). We can add contractual language that default inference and logs for the NordBank tenant are processed and stored in EU regions only; we would disable cross-region routing for your tenant.
- Note: for certain disaster recovery runbooks we have fallbacks, but for regulated customers we can gate fallback to only EU regions or a dedicated DR runbook. We’ll include explicit SLOs and routing guarantees in the contract.

Dedicated vs Private:
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools in a single region (EU) with strict tenancy and a VPC peering option. Lower commercial delta than Private, good middle ground when you want predictable throughput.
- Private VPC / on-prem: supports VPC-hosted in an EU cloud region today; on-prem appliance is available but has longer lead times and a higher MRC. Both support customer-managed KMS/HSM.

KMS: we support BYOK via integration with major cloud KMS providers; HSM options available for Private deployments.

Commercial delta: ballpark guidance — Hosted (EU-only) baseline; Dedicated ~+30–60% relative to Hosted depending on size and committed throughput; Private VPC/on-prem typically +80–150% and an additional setup fee. We’ll follow up with formal pricing ranges.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Technical deep-dive with Lukas + Vivek — Wed 28 Jul 10:00 CET works for us.
2) I’ll attach a short draft SOW and a region-availability matrix (attached).
3) Post-tech-call we’ll produce a short commercial options memo comparing Hosted (with residency contract), Dedicated, and Private with estimated deltas.

Thanks — Lukas, Vivek: can you confirm the network/VPC checklist items and an estimated lead time for Private VPC or on-prem?

Best,
Marissa

Hi Sofie / team —

Quick technical note and checklist so you have what procurement/IT will ask for at the tech deep-dive: 

Network / VPC checklist (Private VPC or Dedicated with peering):
- CIDR ranges and preferred peering method (VPC peering/Transit Gateway).
- Egress control: we can restrict outbound traffic to specific endpoints and IP ranges; no default internet egress for inference nodes unless requested.
- PrivateLink equivalents supported on major clouds; we can provide service endpoints in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.
- Audit logs: configurable retention window; logs can be routed to your SIEM over TLS.
- BYOK: KMS integration steps and policy templates attached.

Estimated lead times:
- Dedicated (EU region) setup: 2–4 weeks after PO and network info.
- Private VPC (cloud-hosted, customer-managed network): 3–6 weeks depending on network review and IP allocations.
- On-prem appliance: 8–12 weeks and additional ops integration work.

I’ve attached a one-page checklist and the BYOK integration guide. Happy to go through this in the Wed 28 Jul 10:00 CET call.

Regards,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
